questions.questionText: Law of Demand states that as price increases, quantity demanded:
questions.explanation: Inverse relationship exists between price and quantity demanded.

questions.questionText: Point where market Demand curve intersects Supply curve:
questions.explanation: Market equilibrium occurs where Q_demand = Q_supply.

questions.questionText: Measure of responsiveness of quantity demanded to price change:
questions.explanation: % change in Q divided by % change in Price.

questions.questionText: Cost of next best alternative foregone when choice is made:
questions.explanation: Fundamental economic concept of trade-off value.

questions.questionText: Good for which demand increases as consumer income increases:
questions.explanation: Normal goods have positive income elasticity.
